title: Bamaboo utensil holder.
text: Bamaboo utensil holder.. A lot smaller than I thought it would be, guess I didn't read all the way through so I will use it in the RV.  Just bought a ceramic red utentsil now that is larger for my kitchen and is red.  Right now I am using this bamboo holder in my kitchen to hold a few small items until my new red one comes.
